reviews.quote: the Surface Pro 11's Qualcomm Snapdragon X Elite finally breaks the mold, delivering surprisingly competitive performance and a lot fewer compatibility issues for mainstream use
It hits the peak brightness of about 890 nits in a 10% window and roughly 650 nits in full screen, plus close to 575 nits in standard mode.

professional.notes: CNET's review config was X Elite/16GB/1TB OLED; this 512GB twin differs only in storage. NBC bot-walled at research time (see SHARED-surface-pro.md).

praises: OLED 120Hz screen is the headline — BBY's 4.56★/256 reviews repeatedly call it the best tablet display available
All-day battery with performance that doesn't throttle on battery (CNET-verified, echoed by users)
Fanless silence; CNET noted it only gets warm while plugged in under heavy load
NPU 'blew the Core Ultra away' (CNET) — best-in-class local AI acceleration at launch
Flex Keyboard doubles usable life as a real laptop; kickstand smoothness praised
complaints: Flex Keyboard + Slim Pen add CA$400-560 on top — CNET con: 'Optional Pen and keyboard can get expensive'
16GB shared with the Adreno GPU runs out under heavy multitasking — CNET con: '16GB is not enough'
DX12 gaming weak ('Mixed graphics performance' per CNET); Vulkan fine, DX12 poor
No 3.5mm headphone jack; two USB-C ports only
Glossy OLED shows the stylus digitizer grid on white backgrounds (CNET); reflections outdoors

design_philosophy: The definitive Surface Pro: OLED 120Hz display, Snapdragon X Elite with a 45-TOPS NPU, and a fanless 895 g magnesium chassis Microsoft pitched as the AI PC benchmark. This 16/512 OLED tier is the volume seller at CA retail (BBY 4.56★/256) — full OLED experience at the lowest X Elite price point.
rating_notes: Directly anchored on CNET 8.3 (as-reviewed 16/1TB OLED; this 512GB twin differs only in storage → storage-irrelevant to ratings except creative_work file headroom). Users rate slightly higher than pro (BBY 4.56★ ≈ 9.1) — screen/battery praised more than review emphasized; heat-while-charging complaint matches CNET. Ecosystem 7.5 for ARM Windows translation caveats per dataset calibration.
